About VibeUp

Building culture through premium experiences

VibeUp Events & Services was founded in Los Angeles to produce nights that feel elegant, emotionally resonant, and operationally sharp. We work where cultural relevance, hospitality, and luxury presentation need to live in the same room without friction.

Explore Events Book A Consultation

We produce events for clients who want the room to feel expensive, the timing to feel calm, and the memory to last longer than the moment itself.

Our Story

Founded in Los Angeles, built for a wider audience

Since 2018, VibeUp has grown from boutique cultural activations into a premium event company producing public nights, private celebrations, and branded experiences with the same luxury-standard operating model.

Base Market

Los Angeles, California

Los Angeles remains the center of our venue network, audience insight, and creative identity.

Community Reach

Arab-American and beyond

Our work resonates with culturally engaged guests while staying premium and globally legible.

Operating Style

Luxury with discipline

We balance atmosphere, elegance, and operational control instead of overproduced noise.

Client Promise

Full-service clarity

Planning, production, hospitality, and storytelling move under one clear creative direction.

Values

Standards that shape the brand

Luxury means very little without substance. These are the internal standards that guide how we design, communicate, and execute every project.

Excellence

We design for polish, clarity, and execution quality because premium brands are judged in details more than declarations.

Authenticity

Cultural relevance is never surface-level. We respect atmosphere, audience, and identity while translating them into modern experiences.

Community

Our strongest events do more than entertain. They build belonging, conversation, memory, and long-term loyalty.

Leadership

The team behind the experience

The company is intentionally cross-functional. Creative direction, production management, partnerships, and audience strategy all sit close enough together to keep quality high and decisions fast.

Founder & Executive Producer

Rami Farid

Rami leads the commercial vision, show direction, and guest-experience philosophy behind VibeUp’s premium event portfolio.

Creative Director

Lina Haddad

Lina shapes the visual language, styling direction, and editorial finish that makes every production feel cinematic and intentional.

Production Manager

Omar Rahman

Omar oversees timelines, technical partners, and on-site coordination with a calm operational style built for complex live events.

Marketing Lead

Sara Nabil

Sara manages campaign strategy, community visibility, and launch momentum across VibeUp’s public and ticketed experiences.

Milestones

How the company has grown

Each stage of growth was tied to stronger room scale, broader audience trust, and a sharper operational model.

Year

2018

Founded In Los Angeles

VibeUp launched with a mission to produce elevated Arab-American experiences with premium execution.

Year

2019

First 500-Person Event

Our production model scaled into larger guest counts without losing intimacy, service rhythm, or visual identity.

Year

2021

Expansion To Three Cities

We extended operations and partnerships across multiple markets while keeping one luxury-standard production process.

Year

2023

10,000 Guest Milestone

A major signal that VibeUp had evolved from boutique organizer into a recognized premium event company.

Year

2025

International Momentum

Our concepts, partnerships, and audience reach positioned the brand for broader luxury-cultural expansion.
